{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct biomarker_final for batch B: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
total_mean = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(f'Mean week-12 biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {total_mean}')"}
